## Blockquote.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `textColor` :: The ink of the quoted passage; secondary by default so the quotation reads as an aside. @default 'text-secondary'
- `children` :: The quoted text, and an optional citation.

## Heading.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `level` :: The heading level, 1 to 4. Pick the one that fits the page outline.
- `scale` :: The visual scale, 1 to 4. Follows `level` when omitted.
- `children` :: The heading text.

## InlineCode.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `textSize` :: The scale of the snippet, one step below running text so it does not jump out of the line. @default 'text-sm'
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the chip. @default 'curved'
- `children` :: The code snippet.

## List.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `as` :: `ul` is a bulleted list; `ol` is a numbered one.
- `gap` :: Space between the list items on the shared gap ladder. @default 'gap-xs'
- `children` :: The list items, as `<li>` elements.

## Text.svelte

### `interface Props`
- `textSize` :: The scale of the paragraph: `text-sm` for a caption, `text-md` for body copy, `text-lg` for a lead.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the paragraph, when it should not be the body ink.

- `look` :: `body` is running copy, `lead` is the opening paragraph, `muted` is secondary, `large` and `small` change the scale.
- `as` :: The element to render. @default 'p'
- `children` :: The text, rendered into the element named by `as`.

## Typography.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `align` :: `center` is a centred reading measure; `left` and `right` pin it to that edge.
- `children` :: The typographic stack — headings, paragraphs, lists and quotes.
